```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
cat("Write your brief on this page. Four elements, in this order. Keep it to one side of A4:\n")
cat("a brief that needs a second page is not being read by the person who decides.\n\n")

for (i in seq_len(nrow(brief_elements))) {
  cat(sprintf("## %d. %s  *(%s)*\n\n", i, brief_elements$element[i], brief_elements$length_guide[i]))
  cat(sprintf("*What this element has to do.* %s\n\n", brief_elements$asks[i]))
  cat("......................................................................................\n\n")
  cat("......................................................................................\n\n")
  cat("......................................................................................\n\n")
  if (i < nrow(brief_elements)) cat("\\newpage\n\n")
}

cat("# Before you hand it over\n\n")
cat("Check your own draft against the checklist. Each of these has caught somebody in this room.\n\n")
cat("- Does the headline sentence contain **the number**? A reader who stops after one sentence\n")
cat("  should not be able to conclude the opposite of what you found.\n")
cat("- Does the recommendation follow from the **finding you chose as headline**, or from a\n")
cat("  different one?\n")
cat("- Have you claimed anything that one of the findings **does not license**? Check the last\n")
cat("  page of the findings pack.\n")
cat("- Is the risk you named something that could actually happen, and could be watched? A risk\n")
cat("  that cannot be observed is not a risk, it is a caveat.\n")
cat("- Would you sign this if your name were on it and the decision went wrong?\n")
```
